_about: Model constants. Physical correlations are used as published; the scale factors marked 'cal' are tuned so the model reproduces the reference points listed in 'references'. Change them only together with tests/test_engine.js.

references.what: VW Scirocco 2.0 TSI CAWB, 147 kW (200 PS) at 5100-6000 rpm, 280 Nm at 1700-5000 rpm
stock Gen 1 high-pressure fuel pump saturates around 280-300 PS on 98 RON
references.source: tuning community consensus (APR/Autotech HPFP upgrade guidance), approximate

references.what: Knock-limited spark advance targets used to fit the Douaud-Eyzat constants (deg BTDC, lambda 0.8): 98 RON stock CAWB 2000 rpm/0.9 bar ~5, 3500/0.95 ~9, 5000/0.95 ~13, 6000/0.8 ~17.5; 98 RON K04 5000/1.6 bar ~9; 95 RON 7500/1.9 bar ~15.5; 98 RON 7000/1.8 bar ~17.5; E85 5500/1.9 bar ~22; E85 7000/2.4 bar ~24
references.source: engineering estimates from published MED17 full-load logs and boosted DI knock-limit literature; approximate (+/-3 deg)
references.fit: tests/test_engine.js checks the model stays within 3 deg of these points
